Class CompleteShooter

java.lang.Object
org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.subsystems.CompleteShooter
All Implemented Interfaces:
dev.nextftc.core.subsystems.Subsystem
public final class CompleteShooter extends Object implements dev.nextftc.core.subsystems.Subsystem
Coordinates intake, vision-guided aiming, blocker and upper feed motor. Continuous feed does NOT detect when storage is empty. Call periodic() exactly once per OpMode loop; do not also call AutoAim.periodic().
